name: js_atom_unref

ownership.argument: Third step of the property-definition composition: create the atom, define, then release it unconditionally, including on the error path.

provenance.source: Guards atom > 211 (the atom table base), takes the entry pointer from the table at rt+56, decrements its reference count and frees the string through the ctx free path when it reaches zero. An inlined twin with the same body sits at 0xC2780D4.

notes: Third step of the property-definition composition: create the atom, define, then release it unconditionally, including on the error path.
